text:
nina: quick pet photo drop! cleo tried to give the ficus a bubble bath. please enjoy: https://i.imgur.com/cleobath.jpg :sweat_smile: :leafy_green:

ty: oh wow. cleo is the most extra plant mom i know. those bubbles!! :joy:

axel: this looks staged but i demand more. did you put shampoo in the water? :thinking:

cleo: 100% unscripted. she jumped in when i leaned over. no shampoo i promise. i did give a tiny squeaky duck as consolation and now it lives on the ficus shelf. :duck:

bot-pics: uploaded 3 images to #pet-photos: cleo_bubble1.jpg, cleo_bubble2.jpg, ficus_duck.jpg

nina: best caption contest:
1) "Ficus Spa Day: BYOB (Bring Your Own Bark)"
2) "Cleo's Bubble PR Campaign"
3) "When your dog prefers potted plants to puddles"

ty: vote 3. it reads like a headline. :newspaper:

axel: vote 1. need that pun real bad.

cleo: vote 2 because it sounds like she's launching a startup. :rocket:

nina: ok close vote. i'll add 'Cleo's Bubble PR Campaign' to Friday slide deck and credit the duck as visual consultant. also can someone add this to the pet calendar?

bot-pics: added event "Cleo Bubble Drop" to pet-photo-calendar for Friday at 10:00am.

axel: shoutout to Cleo for bringing content AND morale. also if anyone needs a sticker design, i can try a tiny duck+bubble icon.

cleo: thank you! she actually snoozed on the ficus after, bless her. :zzz: 

nina: photo dump saved to #pets-photos and to my 'mood' folder. happiness metric +12.
